title: Migration header still claims tokens mint lazily at first link request; round-2 W1 fix mints them at save
evidence:
Migration header (lines 22-25):
-- continue_token is 288 bits of URL-safe entropy (wisp.random_string(48)),
-- same capability model as application.erasure_token: the token IS the
-- auth. Partial unique index — most rows have NULL (token minted lazily on
-- the first "email me a link" request).

vs server/src/application/sql/upsert_application_draft.sql (worktree):
-- Insert or replace the field values for (vacancy, lower(email)). The
-- continue token is minted at SAVE time (COALESCE keeps an existing one) so
-- every live draft is reachable by the stage-2 reminder's continue-link,
-- not just drafts whose applicant clicked "email me a link" (W1).
detail: Round-2 changelog records 'W1: tokens mint at SAVE time', so nearly every auto-saved draft row carries a token; the migration's 'most rows have NULL (token minted lazily)' rationale for the partial index is stale. Migrations are immutable once merged (AGENTS.md).
recommended_fix: Update the header comment before merge to state tokens mint at save time (COALESCE preserves an existing one), so the partial-index rationale stays accurate.

title: Spec review-order caption still says the expiry sweep covers archived vacancies, contradicting the W4 fix and the SQL
evidence:
Spec Suggested Review Order (line 245):
- Expiry sweep phase: closed, archived, or past closes_at.

vs the same file's round-2 changelog (lines 154-155):
  W4: archive no longer sweeps drafts (restorable; the emailed promise is
  "until the vacancy closes").

vs server/src/retention/sql/delete_expired_application_drafts.sql (worktree):
-- Archived vacancies keep their drafts: archiving is
-- restorable (AGENTS.md), the emailed promise is "until the vacancy
-- closes" ... WHERE ... v.status = 'closed' OR (v.closes_at IS NOT NULL AND v.closes_at <= now())
detail: The W4 round-1 fix removed archived vacancies from the draft sweep, and the committed SQL excludes them, but the spec's Suggested Review Order caption still describes the pre-fix behaviour ('closed, archived, or past closes_at') — internal contradiction misdirecting reviewers.
recommended_fix: Change the caption to 'Expiry sweep phase: closed or past closes_at (archived vacancies keep drafts)' to match the W4 changelog entry and delete_expired_application_drafts.sql.
